Slide 2 (Top 10 Models) must use a table or chart to present the ranking data.
Slide 3 (Provider Market Share) must use a pie chart or bar chart to show the share distribution.
Do not fabricate any data or statistics not found in source_brief.md.

2. **Read `/app/benchmark/task_input.json`**  for **structural requirements**: deck metadata (slide count, aspect ratio, audience, tone) and a per-slide outline (id, title, objective) that your presentation must follow.

## Output Requirements

Save the final PPT to `/app/output/final_deck.pptx`.

Only the correctly saved final file is needed — no additional explanation is required.

---

## Automated Execution Rules

There is no human operator online for this session. Follow these rules:

1. **Skip all confirmation/approval/user-input steps** — do not pause, ask questions, or wait for a reply. When encountering BLOCKING or "wait for user confirmation" instructions, make a professional judgment and proceed.
2. **Design decisions** — if `task_input.json` specifies fields such as `deck.tone` or `deck.audience`, use them to guide template, color palette, and style choices; otherwise, use your professional judgment.

4. **Priority** — these rules take precedence over any interactive-wait instructions in SKILL.md. The workflow, quality standards, and technical specifications in SKILL.md remain in effect; only interactive waits are skipped.

3	## Data Source
4	OpenRouter is one of the largest LLM API aggregation platforms, capturing real usage data from millions of users. The data below is sourced from the OpenRouter Rankings page (https://openrouter.ai/rankings) and covers the most recent week of March 2025.
5

16	| 1 | MiMo-V2-Pro | Xiaomi | 3.96T | +165% |
17	| 2 | Step 3.5 Flash (free) | Stepfun | 1.49T | +1% |
18	| 3 | MiniMax M2.7 | MiniMax | 1.29T | +253% |

55	- OpenAI ranks only fifth at 7.9%
56	- The market is highly fragmented — no single provider exceeds 30%

76	| 2 | Kilo Code | VS Code AI coding assistant | 271B |
77	| 3 | Claude Code | Anthropic's CLI coding tool | 78B |
78	| 4 | Cline | VS Code autonomous coding agent | 69.1B |
79	| 5 | Janitor AI | Character roleplay chat | 29.2B |
80	| 6 | ISEKAI ZERO | AI adventure game | 28.8B |
81	| 7 | Descript | AI video/podcast editor | 27B |
82	| 8 | Hermes Agent | Nous Research's AI agent | 19.2B |
83	| 9 | Roo Code | VS Code AI coding assistant | 11.8B |
84	| 10 | Scripty | Newly launched tool | 9.95B |
85	
86	**Key Findings**:
87	- The top 4 apps are all **AI coding tools** (OpenClaw, Kilo Code, Claude Code, Cline)
88	- AI coding agents have become the single largest LLM consumption scenario
89	- Entertainment/roleplay apps (Janitor AI, ISEKAI ZERO) still hold a notable presence
90	- OpenClaw consumes 829B tokens per day — nearly 3× the second-place app
91	
92	## Industry Trend Observations
93	
94	1. **Chinese Models Break Through Globally**: On OpenRouter, an international platform, Chinese provider models now account for over half of all usage. Xiaomi's MiMo series, DeepSeek V3, and MiniMax's M2 series hold a significant cost-performance advantage.
95

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build the 7-slide LLM Usage Landscape deck."""

from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt, Emu
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN, MSO_ANCHOR
from pptx.enum.chart import XL_CHART_TYPE, XL_LABEL_POSITION, XL_LEGEND_POSITION
from pptx.chart.data import CategoryChartData, ChartData
import math

# ── Constants ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
SLIDE_W = Inches(13.333)
SLIDE_H = Inches(7.5)

# Color palette — dark, data-forward
BG_DARK    = RGBColor(0x0F, 0x17, 0x2A)
BG_CARD    = RGBColor(0x16, 0x21, 0x3A)
ACCENT     = RGBColor(0x38, 0xBD, 0xF8)  # cyan
ACCENT2    = RGBColor(0xA7, 0x8B, 0xFA)  # purple
ACCENT3    = RGBColor(0x34, 0xD3, 0x99)  # green
WARN       = RGBColor(0xFB, 0xBF, 0x24)  # amber
WHITE      = RGBColor(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF)
LIGHT_GRAY = RGBColor(0x94, 0xA3, 0xB8)
MID_GRAY   = RGBColor(0x64, 0x74, 0x8B)
DARK_TEXT   = RGBColor(0xCB, 0xD5, 0xE1)

PIE_COLORS = [
    RGBColor(0x38, 0xBD, 0xF8),  # Xiaomi - cyan
    RGBColor(0x34, 0xD3, 0x99),  # Google - green
    RGBColor(0xA7, 0x8B, 0xFA),  # Anthropic - purple
    RGBColor(0xFB, 0xBF, 0x24),  # MiniMax - amber
    RGBColor(0xF8, 0x71, 0x71),  # OpenAI - red
    RGBColor(0x2D, 0xD4, 0xBF),  # Stepfun - teal
    RGBColor(0x60, 0xA5, 0xFA),  # DeepSeek - blue
    RGBColor(0xC0, 0x84, 0xFC),  # Zhipu - violet
    RGBColor(0xF9, 0x73, 0x16),  # x-ai - orange
    RGBColor(0x64, 0x74, 0x8B),  # Others - gray
]

BAR_COLORS = [
    RGBColor(0x38, 0xBD, 0xF8),
    RGBColor(0x2D, 0xD4, 0xBF),
    RGBColor(0xFB, 0xBF, 0x24),
    RGBColor(0x34, 0xD3, 0x99),
    RGBColor(0xA7, 0x8B, 0xFA),
    RGBColor(0xF8, 0x71, 0x71),
    RGBColor(0x60, 0xA5, 0xFA),
    RGBColor(0xC0, 0x84, 0xFC),
    RGBColor(0xF9, 0x73, 0x16),
    RGBColor(0x64, 0x74, 0x8B),
]


# ── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def set_slide_bg(slide, color):
    bg = slide.background
    fill = bg.fill
    fill.solid()
    fill.fore_color.rgb = color


def add_textbox(slide, left, top, width, height, text, font_size=18,
                color=WHITE, bold=False, alignment=PP_ALIGN.LEFT,
                font_name="Calibri"):
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.text = text
    p.font.size = Pt(font_size)
    p.font.color.rgb = color
    p.font.bold = bold
    p.font.name = font_name
    p.alignment = alignment
    return txBox


def add_rounded_rect(slide, left, top, width, height, fill_color):
    from pptx.enum.shapes import MSO_SHAPE
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE,
                                   left, top, width, height)
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = fill_color
    shape.line.fill.background()
    shape.shadow.inherit = False
    return shape


def add_multi_para_textbox(slide, left, top, width, height, items,
                           font_size=16, color=WHITE, font_name="Calibri",
                           line_spacing=1.5):
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    for i, item in enumerate(items):
        if i == 0:
            p = tf.paragraphs[0]
        else:
            p = tf.add_paragraph()
        p.text = item
        p.font.size = Pt(font_size)
        p.font.color.rgb = color
        p.font.name = font_name
        p.space_after = Pt(font_size * (line_spacing - 1))
    return txBox


# ── Build Presentation ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

prs = Presentation()
prs.slide_width = SLIDE_W
prs.slide_height = SLIDE_H

blank_layout = prs.slide_layouts[6]  # blank

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SLIDE 1 — Title
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(blank_layout)
set_slide_bg(slide, BG_DARK)

add_textbox(slide, Inches(1.2), Inches(1.8), Inches(11), Inches(1.2),
            "The 2025 LLM Usage Landscape:\nReal-World Data from OpenRouter",
            font_size=38, color=WHITE, bold=True, alignment=PP_ALIGN.LEFT)

# accent line
add_rounded_rect(slide, Inches(1.2), Inches(3.45), Inches(2.5), Pt(4), ACCENT)

add_textbox(slide, Inches(1.2), Inches(3.7), Inches(9), Inches(0.5),
            "Data Source: OpenRouter Rankings  |  Latest Week of March 2025",
            font_size=18, color=LIGHT_GRAY, alignment=PP_ALIGN.LEFT)

add_textbox(slide, Inches(1.2), Inches(4.3), Inches(9), Inches(0.5),
            "Based on real usage data from millions of users across the world's largest LLM API aggregation platform.",
            font_size=15, color=MID_GRAY, alignment=PP_ALIGN.LEFT)

# Big metric
add_rounded_rect(slide, Inches(1.2), Inches(5.2), Inches(3.8), Inches(1.4), BG_CARD)
add_textbox(slide, Inches(1.5), Inches(5.3), Inches(3.2), Inches(0.6),
            "26T+", font_size=44, color=ACCENT, bold=True)
add_textbox(slide, Inches(1.5), Inches(5.95), Inches(3.2), Inches(0.5),
            "Tokens processed this week", font_size=15, color=LIGHT_GRAY)

add_rounded_rect(slide, Inches(5.5), Inches(5.2), Inches(3.8), Inches(1.4), BG_CARD)
add_textbox(slide, Inches(5.8), Inches(5.3), Inches(3.2), Inches(0.6),
            "54.3%", font_size=44, color=ACCENT3, bold=True)
add_textbox(slide, Inches(5.8), Inches(5.95), Inches(3.2), Inches(0.5),
            "Market share held by Chinese providers", font_size=15, color=LIGHT_GRAY)

add_rounded_rect(slide, Inches(9.8), Inches(5.2), Inches(3.0), Inches(1.4), BG_CARD)
add_textbox(slide, Inches(10.1), Inches(5.3), Inches(2.5), Inches(0.6),
            "8", font_size=44, color=ACCENT2, bold=True)
add_textbox(slide, Inches(10.1), Inches(5.95), Inches(2.5), Inches(0.5),
            "Providers in Top 10 models", font_size=15, color=LIGHT_GRAY)


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SLIDE 2 — Top 10 Models (TABLE)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(blank_layout)
set_slide_bg(slide, BG_DARK)

add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(0.4), Inches(10), Inches(0.7),
            "This Week's Top 10 Models",
            font_size=30, color=WHITE, bold=True)
add_rounded_rect(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(1.05), Inches(2), Pt(3), ACCENT)

models_data = [
    ("Rank", "Model", "Provider", "Weekly Tokens", "WoW Change"),
    ("1", "MiMo-V2-Pro", "Xiaomi", "3.96T", "+165%"),
    ("2", "Step 3.5 Flash (free)", "Stepfun", "1.49T", "+1%"),
    ("3", "MiniMax M2.7", "MiniMax", "1.29T", "+253%"),
    ("4", "DeepSeek V3.2", "DeepSeek", "1.24T", "+9%"),
    ("5", "Claude Sonnet 4.6", "Anthropic", "1.04T", "-0%"),
    ("6", "Claude Opus 4.6", "Anthropic", "995B", "+2%"),
    ("7", "Gemini 3 Flash Preview", "Google", "972B", "+3%"),
    ("8", "GLM 5 Turbo", "Zhipu (z-ai)", "968B", "-6%"),
    ("9", "MiniMax M2.5", "MiniMax", "909B", "-30%"),
    ("10", "Grok 4.1 Fast", "x-ai", "599B", "+32%"),
]

rows, cols = len(models_data), 5
col_widths = [Inches(0.8), Inches(3.2), Inches(2.0), Inches(2.0), Inches(1.8)]
table_width = sum(c for c in col_widths)
tbl_shape = slide.shapes.add_table(rows, cols,
                                   Inches(0.8), Inches(1.35),
                                   table_width, Inches(5.4))
table = tbl_shape.table

for i, w in enumerate(col_widths):
    table.columns[i].width = w

for r, row_data in enumerate(models_data):
    for c, val in enumerate(row_data):
        cell = table.cell(r, c)
        cell.text = val
        for paragraph in cell.text_frame.paragraphs:
            paragraph.font.size = Pt(13) if r > 0 else Pt(13)
            paragraph.font.name = "Calibri"
            paragraph.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER if c in (0, 3, 4) else PP_ALIGN.LEFT
            if r == 0:
                paragraph.font.bold = True
                paragraph.font.color.rgb = ACCENT
            else:
                paragraph.font.color.rgb = WHITE
                if c == 4:
                    if val.startswith("+") and val not in ("+0%", "-0%"):
                        paragraph.font.color.rgb = ACCENT3
                    elif val.startswith("-") and val != "-0%":
                        paragraph.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0xF8, 0x71, 0x71)
        cell.vertical_anchor = MSO_ANCHOR.MIDDLE
        # cell fill
        fill = cell.fill
        fill.solid()
        if r == 0:
            fill.fore_color.rgb = RGBColor(0x1E, 0x29, 0x3B)
        elif r % 2 == 0:
            fill.fore_color.rgb = RGBColor(0x13, 0x1C, 0x30)
        else:
            fill.fore_color.rgb = BG_DARK
        # borders — set to minimal
        from pptx.oxml.ns import qn
        tc = cell._tc
        tcPr = tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
        for border_name in ['a:lnL', 'a:lnR', 'a:lnT', 'a:lnB']:
            ln = tcPr.find(qn(border_name))
            if ln is None:
                from lxml import etree
                ln = etree.SubElement(tcPr, qn(border_name))
            ln.set('w', '0')
            noFill = ln.find(qn('a:noFill'))
            if noFill is None:
                from lxml import etree
                etree.SubElement(ln, qn('a:noFill'))

# Highlight callout
add_rounded_rect(slide, Inches(10.3), Inches(1.35), Inches(2.6), Inches(2.2), BG_CARD)
add_textbox(slide, Inches(10.5), Inches(1.5), Inches(2.2), Inches(0.4),
            "6 of Top 10", font_size=22, color=ACCENT, bold=True, alignment=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
add_textbox(slide, Inches(10.5), Inches(2.0), Inches(2.2), Inches(0.8),
            "models are from\nChinese providers", font_size=14, color=LIGHT_GRAY, alignment=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

add_rounded_rect(slide, Inches(10.3), Inches(3.8), Inches(2.6), Inches(2.2), BG_CARD)
add_textbox(slide, Inches(10.5), Inches(3.95), Inches(2.2), Inches(0.4),
            "#1 MiMo-V2-Pro", font_size=18, color=WARN, bold=True, alignment=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
add_textbox(slide, Inches(10.5), Inches(4.45), Inches(2.2), Inches(0.8),
            "3.96T tokens\n+165% WoW growth", font_size=14, color=LIGHT_GRAY, alignment=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SLIDE 3 — Provider Market Share (PIE CHART)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(blank_layout)
set_slide_bg(slide, BG_DARK)

add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(0.4), Inches(10), Inches(0.7),
            "Provider Market Share Breakdown",
            font_size=30, color=WHITE, bold=True)
add_rounded_rect(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(1.05), Inches(2), Pt(3), ACCENT)

add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(1.25), Inches(10), Inches(0.45),
            "Share of total weekly token volume across all models and apps (including those outside the top 10)",
            font_size=13, color=MID_GRAY)

# Pie chart
chart_data = ChartData()
chart_data.categories = [
    "Xiaomi (25.9%)", "Google (11.8%)", "Anthropic (11.0%)",
    "MiniMax (8.5%)", "OpenAI (7.9%)", "Stepfun (6.8%)",
    "DeepSeek (6.6%)", "Zhipu (6.5%)", "x-ai (3.9%)", "Others (11.2%)"
]
chart_data.add_series("Market Share", (25.9, 11.8, 11.0, 8.5, 7.9, 6.8, 6.6, 6.5, 3.9, 11.2))

chart_frame = slide.shapes.add_chart(
    XL_CHART_TYPE.PIE, Inches(0.5), Inches(1.8),
    Inches(7.5), Inches(5.4), chart_data
)
chart = chart_frame.chart
chart.has_legend = True
chart.legend.position = XL_LEGEND_POSITION.LEFT
chart.legend.include_in_layout = False
chart.legend.font.size = Pt(11)
chart.legend.font.color.rgb = LIGHT_GRAY

plot = chart.plots[0]
plot.has_data_labels = True
data_labels = plot.data_labels
data_labels.font.size = Pt(10)
data_labels.font.color.rgb = WHITE
data_labels.show_percentage = True
data_labels.show_category_name = False
data_labels.show_value = False

# Color each slice
series = chart.series[0]
for i, color in enumerate(PIE_COLORS):
    point = series.points[i]
    point.format.fill.solid()
    point.format.fill.fore_color.rgb = color

# Set chart background transparent
chart.chart_style = 2
from pptx.oxml.ns import qn as _qn
chart_space = chart._chartSpace
for bg_elem in chart_space.iter(_qn('c:plotArea')):
    pass

# Right side insights
add_rounded_rect(slide, Inches(8.3), Inches(1.8), Inches(4.5), Inches(1.4), BG_CARD)
add_textbox(slide, Inches(8.5), Inches(1.9), Inches(4.1), Inches(0.4),
            "Chinese Providers Combined", font_size=16, color=ACCENT3, bold=True)
add_textbox(slide, Inches(8.5), Inches(2.35), Inches(4.1), Inches(0.3),
            "54.3%", font_size=36, color=ACCENT3, bold=True)
add_textbox(slide, Inches(8.5), Inches(2.85), Inches(4.1), Inches(0.3),
            "Xiaomi + MiniMax + Stepfun + DeepSeek + Zhipu",
            font_size=11, color=MID_GRAY)

add_rounded_rect(slide, Inches(8.3), Inches(3.5), Inches(4.5), Inches(1.2), BG_CARD)
add_textbox(slide, Inches(8.5), Inches(3.6), Inches(4.1), Inches(0.3),
            "Xiaomi Leads at 25.9%", font_size=16, color=ACCENT, bold=True)
add_textbox(slide, Inches(8.5), Inches(3.95), Inches(4.1), Inches(0.5),
            "More than double second-place Google (11.8%)",
            font_size=13, color=LIGHT_GRAY)

add_rounded_rect(slide, Inches(8.3), Inches(5.0), Inches(4.5), Inches(1.2), BG_CARD)
add_textbox(slide, Inches(8.5), Inches(5.1), Inches(4.1), Inches(0.3),
            "OpenAI Ranks Only 5th", font_size=16, color=WARN, bold=True)
add_textbox(slide, Inches(8.5), Inches(5.45), Inches(4.1), Inches(0.5),
            "At 7.9% — behind Xiaomi, Google, Anthropic, and MiniMax",
            font_size=13, color=LIGHT_GRAY)


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SLIDE 4 — Shifts in the Market Landscape
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(blank_layout)
set_slide_bg(slide, BG_DARK)

add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(0.4), Inches(10), Inches(0.7),
            "Shifts in the Market Landscape",
            font_size=30, color=WHITE, bold=True)
add_rounded_rect(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(1.05), Inches(2), Pt(3), ACCENT)

# Three column cards
card_w = Inches(3.6)
card_h = Inches(4.6)
gap = Inches(0.4)
start_x = Inches(0.8)
card_y = Inches(1.5)

# Card 1 — Chinese models
add_rounded_rect(slide, start_x, card_y, card_w, card_h, BG_CARD)
add_textbox(slide, start_x + Inches(0.3), card_y + Inches(0.3), card_w - Inches(0.6), Inches(0.4),
            "Chinese Models Break Through", font_size=18, color=ACCENT, bold=True)
add_textbox(slide, start_x + Inches(0.3), card_y + Inches(0.85), card_w - Inches(0.6), Inches(0.5),
            "54.3%", font_size=42, color=ACCENT, bold=True)
add_textbox(slide, start_x + Inches(0.3), card_y + Inches(1.55), card_w - Inches(0.6), Inches(0.35),
            "combined share on an international platform",
            font_size=13, color=MID_GRAY)
txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(start_x + Inches(0.3), card_y + Inches(2.1),
                                 card_w - Inches(0.6), Inches(2.2))
tf = txBox.text_frame
tf.word_wrap = True
providers = ["Xiaomi — 25.9% (#1)", "MiniMax — 8.5%", "Stepfun — 6.8%",
             "DeepSeek — 6.6%", "Zhipu — 6.5%"]
for i, prov in enumerate(providers):
    p = tf.paragraphs[0] if i == 0 else tf.add_paragraph()
    p.text = "  •  " + prov
    p.font.size = Pt(13)
    p.font.color.rgb = LIGHT_GRAY
    p.font.name = "Calibri"
    p.space_after = Pt(4)

# Card 2 — Flash/Turbo dominance
x2 = start_x + card_w + gap
add_rounded_rect(slide, x2, card_y, card_w, card_h, BG_CARD)
add_textbox(slide, x2 + Inches(0.3), card_y + Inches(0.3), card_w - Inches(0.6), Inches(0.4),
            "Flash/Turbo Variants Win", font_size=18, color=ACCENT3, bold=True)
add_textbox(slide, x2 + Inches(0.3), card_y + Inches(0.85), card_w - Inches(0.6), Inches(0.35),
            "Speed & cost > peak performance",
            font_size=14, color=ACCENT3)
txBox2 = slide.shapes.add_textbox(x2 + Inches(0.3), card_y + Inches(1.5),
                                  card_w - Inches(0.6), Inches(2.8))
tf2 = txBox2.text_frame
tf2.word_wrap = True
flash_items = [
    "Step 3.5 Flash — #2 overall (1.49T)",
    "Gemini 3 Flash Preview — #7 (972B)",
    "GLM 5 Turbo — #8 (968B)",
    "Grok 4.1 Fast — #10 (599B)",
    "",
    "Users are voting with their feet: in real-world usage, fast & affordable beats flagship."
]
for i, item in enumerate(flash_items):
    p = tf2.paragraphs[0] if i == 0 else tf2.add_paragraph()
    if item == "":
        p.text = ""
        p.space_after = Pt(6)
        continue
    if i < 4:
        p.text = "  •  " + item
    else:
        p.text = item
    p.font.size = Pt(12) if i < 5 else Pt(11)
    p.font.color.rgb = LIGHT_GRAY if i < 5 else MID_GRAY
    p.font.name = "Calibri"
    if i == 5:
        p.font.italic = True
    p.space_after = Pt(4)

# Card 3 — Market expanding rapidly
x3 = x2 + card_w + gap
add_rounded_rect(slide, x3, card_y, card_w, card_h, BG_CARD)
add_textbox(slide, x3 + Inches(0.3), card_y + Inches(0.3), card_w - Inches(0.6), Inches(0.4),
            "Market Expanding Rapidly", font_size=18, color=ACCENT2, bold=True)
add_textbox(slide, x3 + Inches(0.3), card_y + Inches(0.85), card_w - Inches(0.6), Inches(0.5),
            "~2T → ~26T", font_size=38, color=ACCENT2, bold=True)

def add_textbox(slide, left, top, width, height, text, font_size=18,
                color=WHITE, bold=False, alignment=PP_ALIGN.LEFT,
                font_name="Calibri"):
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.text = text
    p.font.size = Pt(font_size)
    p.font.color.rgb = color
    p.font.bold = bold
    p.font.name = font_name
    p.alignment = alignment
    return txBox


def add_rounded_rect(slide, left, top, width, height, fill_color):
    from pptx.enum.shapes import MSO_SHAPE
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE,
                                   left, top, width, height)
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = fill_color
    shape.line.fill.background()
    shape.shadow.inherit = False
    return shape


def add_multi_para_textbox(slide, left, top, width, height, items,
                           font_size=16, color=WHITE, font_name="Calibri",
                           line_spacing=1.5):
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    for i, item in enumerate(items):
        if i == 0:
            p = tf.paragraphs[0]
        else:
            p = tf.add_paragraph()
        p.text = item
        p.font.size = Pt(font_size)
        p.font.color.rgb = color
        p.font.name = font_name
        p.space_after = Pt(font_size * (line_spacing - 1))
    return txBox
